cues: Larger changes alter the structure of whole chromosomes.
Take a chromosome with segments A to G.
An inversion turns a piece end to end.
And a translocation moves a piece onto a different, non homologous chromosome.
text: Larger changes alter the structure of whole chromosomes. Take a chromosome with segments A to G. A deletion loses a piece. A duplication repeats a piece. An inversion turns a piece end to end. And a translocation moves a piece onto a different, non homologous chromosome.
